text:
maria: quick flag 5m after route-enrich rollout some tenants show tiny positive preview deltas (+0.01-0.04) vs ledger
devon: seen it, sample tenant=beta-studios shows +0.03 on daily line
priya: likely enrichment fanout + retry duplicate attribution events. do we dedupe on a stable key after enrichment?
maria: fingerprint exists but enrichment can change fields used to compute it
devon: short fix: console preview can dedupe on (fingerprint, route_tag) before summing to reduce noise
priya: long fix: canonicalize fingerprint after enrichment (strip transient route attrs). propose 1% canary, compare invoice deltas
maria: emit telemetry from enrich and collector: enrich.fp_out and collector.fp_in plus fp_mismatch counter
billing-bot: suppressing invoice-preview alerts for deltas < 0.05 for 48h (incident BB-5701)
priya: action items: (1) console dedupe + tooltip, (2) telemetry emit, (3) canonicalizer canary, (4) 72h monitor + backfill sample. I'll open ticket and tag eng-platform/eng-sre/product
maria: good. ping here if any tenant exceeds 0.10 delta
